title: Generalized Maiorana--McFarland separation for Section IV partitions
summary: Determine whether a bent partition from the source's Section IV construction can generate a bent function outside the generalized Maiorana--McFarland class.

formal_statement.body: Let $\Gamma$ be a bent partition obtained in Section IV as the preimage-set partition of a vectorial generalized Maiorana--McFarland bent function. Does some admissible $\Gamma$ generate a bent function outside the generalized Maiorana--McFarland class? Construct such a function and certify non-membership using the cited class criterion, or prove that every bent function generated by every admissible Section IV partition belongs to the generalized class.

scope.domain: Bent functions generated from Section IV preimage-set bent partitions
assumptions: The partition is produced by the source's Section IV generalized-Maiorana--McFarland construction
Generalized Maiorana--McFarland membership uses the criterion cited by the source
parameters: balanced labeling that generates the bent function
scope.unresolved_remainder: No generated Section IV function has been certified outside the generalized Maiorana--McFarland class, and no theorem proves containment for the entire construction family. Later nonidentity-sigma constructions address a different predicate.

citations.label: Alkan--Anbar--Kalayci--Meidl, Section IV generalized-MM question
citations.locator: Section VII, second concrete question, p. 766

progress.summary: The source asks for a Section IV generated function outside the generalized class and notes that the relevant Boolean 2-rank results are missing.
